items.q: I booked Miles Davis over there.

Then I would -- eventually -- I think this is around '52 or something -- I opened a booking agent. I started booking bands and singers. Still gigging. I (inaudible) Albany, I used to book New York -- (inaudible) all up around Albany. And Joe Marsh had left Hamp. He come up with a small -- Anybody had a little band or something like that. And I got into -- I used to book some things in Newark every Monday night called Concert In Jam. And Dexter was in town, and I used to book Dexter and I used to book Ben Webster…
